name: pw-educamos-notifier
description: A Playwright-based bot that polls the CLM Educamos platform and forwards received messages to Telegram using PageObject model

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install-deps && npx playwright install
scripts.docker-export: mkdir -p dist && npm run docker-clean && npm run docker-build && docker save -o ./dist/pw-educamos-notifier.tar pw-educamos-notifier

author: Daniel Garcia <dev@danigarcia.org>
